name: Kami Torii Foxfire Runner
lore: A shrine-bound trickster spirit that defends contracts and boundaries; hostile only when a mission violates local spirit law.
visualDescription: Vermilion mask, foxfire tails, lacquer-black footguards, paper seal streamers.
mapBehavior: Flanks the Deity and baits wasted AoE.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; older cross-faction run-ins become easier as Divine Level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +10% damage, +1 tactical mechanic, not raw health sponge tuning.
scaling.endgame: Adds role synergy and objective pressure before raw hp increases.
scaling.levelFormula: hp and damage scale by mission band and device performance caps; mechanics are preferred over inflated health pools.

priority: pressure the lone Avatar from its role
aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Major actions must telegraph through stance, landmark, or lane preview before impact.

balanceNotes: Cross-faction FAST run-in tuned for one deity vs many; lore pressure and role synergy first, raw stats second.

loreGuardrails.sourceCultureRule: source culture humans later copied as Japanese myth and Shinto shrine lore
loreGuardrails.forbidden: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.
